prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Platinum (백금) itself — the sovereign of the Platinum Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: an elegant, refined presence; porcelain-pale skin; diamond-shaped face; medium-sized eyes — wide almond eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; thin arched brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; pale silver-grey eyes; glossy nude lips.
Body and hair: statuesque, long-legged, with a natural neck length build; an asymmetric bob, longer on one side with long bangs falling over one eye; cool satin platinum-white hair with a soft untarnished sheen.
Expression: a cool, unimpressed look.
Her element, carried in her design: platinum: a dense, cool white metal that never changes — it does not rust, tarnish or dissolve in almost any acid; once tossed aside by Spanish gold-washers as worthless 'little silver', it became rarer and costlier than gold; for 130 years a small cylinder of platinum and iridium sealed under three nested glass bell jars was the kilogram itself, the measure of the world; a catalyst that makes hydrogen burst into flame and other substances transform at its touch while it stays untouched; aloof, exacting and incorruptible.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Flawless satin-platinum white armor of perfectly symmetrical, precisely machined plates, fine honeycomb catalyst lattice panels at the waist and back glowing pale blue-white where they meet the air, a sealed cylindrical standard-weight core at the chest under a clear dome, calibration scale lines etched along the limbs; cool, exacting and incorruptible; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: a symmetrical pair of mechanical sub-arms reaching out from her back, ending in shields or tools — her own two human arms stay as they are. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: cool satin platinum white, polished mirror silver, deep vault-black velvet, pale catalytic blue-white flame.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a hydrogen-fuel city: towers of fuel cells glowing wherever hydrogen meets platinum catalyst, walls of fine honeycomb catalyst lattice, a white metrology spire broadcasting the unchanging standard every machine in the city is calibrated to.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Pt) and atomic number (78) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
